_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Iraga Pemain {player_id} ring permainan Liar's Dice antuk {num_players} pemain.
Aturan:
- Ring giliran Iraga, Iraga dados:
  1) Ngajukan bid anyar antuk kuantitas utawi nilai wajah sing lebih tegeh (utawi makakalih) tinimbang bid kantun; contone '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Nelpon bid pinih anyar antuk ngetik '[Call]'.

Yen Iraga nelpon:
  - Yen cacah dadu sing cocok ring nilai wajah sing diitung kurang saking bid, pemain bid pinih anyar kalah.
  - Wenten Iraga, pemain sing nelpon kalah.
Pemain sing kalah dados 0 dados kalah. Pemain sing kantun pinih anyar menang.

board.new_round:
Giliran anyar - Cacah dados sing kantun: {dice_summary}
Dadu Iraga kantun: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Pemain {current_player_id} nelpon! Cacah dadu sing cocok ring nilai wajah {face_value} inggih {count}, sing kurang saking {quantity}.
Pemain {loser_id} (pemain bid pinih anyar) kalah.
call.caller_loses:
Pemain {current_player_id} nelpon! Cacah dadu sing cocok ring nilai wajah {face_value} inggih {count}, sing lebih utawi pateh {quantity}.
Pemain {loser_id} (pemain sing nelpon) kalah.

action.bid_announce: Pemain {player_id} ngajukan bid {quantity} ring nilai wajah {face_value}.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Aksi sing dikirim pemain tanpa dikenal dados '[Bid: X, Y]' utawi '[Call]'. Aksi sing dikirim: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Kuantitas anyar {new_quantity} kurang saking kuantitas kantun {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Nilai muka anyar {new_face_value} luwih alit tekén {current_face_value} sané mangkin.
bid_reason.identical: Bid sing dikirim pateh antuk bid kantun.

message.eliminated_invalid: Pamain {player_id} kaicalang antuk pamargi nénten patut.
